correctness.rationale: The degree-five Clebsch folded cube is the Cayley graph on F_2^4 with jumps 1,2,4,8,15 (not the ten-regular alternate Clebsch graph). A face of the dominance complex is exactly a subset containing no closed neighborhood N[v] entirely; enumeration of all 65,536 masks yields 53,730 nonempty faces, with f-vector through dimension 11 matching source. Independent deterministic toggle matching in vertex order 0..15 yields 26,799 pairs and exactly 132 critical faces: one 0-face and 131 9-faces. Independently oriented all 401,088 nonempty Hasse cover incidences, with paired edges reversed; complete Kahn topological sort visits every face. Forman's theorem gives a CW complex with a point and 131 nine-cells and no intermediate cells, hence wedge of 131 S^9, free integral homology and trivial fundamental group. Exhaustive check is finite for this specific graph, not a family-wide formula.
